components.name: Botón Primario (Azul Caja)
components.description: CTA principal. Azul Caja sobre navy o superficies claras. Aparece en el hero y secciones oscuras.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #1c6fd8; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Botón Ghost (Borde blanco)
components.description: CTA secundario sobre fondos oscuros. Aparece junto al primario en el hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

components.name: Botón Nav CTA

components.css: .ds-btn-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #1c6fd8; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-nav:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-nav:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.css: .ds-cert { border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); background: transparent; } .ds-cert-stripe { height: 4px; background: #1c6fd8; } .ds-cert-body { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; } .ds-cert-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; } .ds-cert-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(28,111,216,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(28,111,216,0.3); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #1c6fd8; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-cert-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; } .ds-cert-divider { height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-cert-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; } .ds-cert-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-cert-item svg { color: #1c6fd8; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-cert-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-cert-footer svg { color: #1c6fd8; }

narrative.overview:
CLINITAXi's visual language is built around a single organizing truth: this is a physical, certified instrument — solid, precise, and officially stamped. The system does not perform modernity; it performs authority. Every surface is either the deep night navy of the device body or the near-white of a clean technical document. The blue arrives as a mark of certification and identity — it is the exact blue of the company's physical pendón and taxi-roof signage, "la caja azul" made literal.

The design is official and precise, like a well-designed government form: structure is always visible, actions are never ambiguous, and ornament earns its presence only when it carries information. The system leans on weight, position, and a disciplined two-blue palette for emphasis. When navy dominates, it means reliability; when the medium blue appears, it means "this is CLINITAXi" or "act now".

The voice is direct and technical without being cold. A taxi driver on a phone should feel, in three seconds, that they have found the right place.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-first surfaces establish authority before the user reads a word
Medium 'caja azul' blue as the brand and certification signal — CTAs, credential icons, nav CTA
Navy header — the fixed nav is the same institutional navy as hero/footer, not the accent blue
Space Grotesk headlines carry the brand's precision; Inter body text keeps it accessible
Saira Condensed italic bold for the 'CLINITAXi' wordmark, echoing the lettering on the company's pendón
JetBrains Mono labels add the 'technical instrument' register in small doses
The pendón swoosh image is the hero's only decorative element — all else is functional
Glassmorphism in the fixed nav is the only depth trick; everything else is flat or tonal

rules.name: La Regla del Azul Caja
rules.body: Azul Caja (#1c6fd8) appears only on: primary CTAs (including the header's nav CTA), the accent stripe of the credential card, and certification icons on dark surfaces — it's the exact blue of the pendón and the taxi-roof box. It never backgrounds a full section, including the header, which stays institutional navy; it certifies and identifies, it does not decorate.

rules.name: La Regla del Éxito
rules.body: Success green (#0f8a4b) is reserved for state feedback — form validation confirmations, certification status chips, completed-step indicators. It is not a section label color.

rules.name: La Regla del Peso
rules.body: Emphasis comes from font weight and size, never from gradient text. A word that needs emphasis becomes Bold (700); a number that matters becomes Extrabold (800). Color alone never carries importance.

rules.name: La Regla de Plano
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The glassmorphism nav and the credential card shadow are the only elevation effects on the page. Adding a third shadow context dilutes all three.

dos: Do use #0e192f navy as the background for authority-bearing sections: hero, TrustBar, footer.
Do treat Azul Caja (#1c6fd8) as the brand and certification signal — reserve it for primary CTAs (including the header's nav CTA) and credential icons.
Do keep the fixed header on institutional navy (#0e192f), matching hero and footer.
Do apply Space Grotesk at 700–800 weight for all section headings.
Do set the 'CLINITAXi' wordmark in Saira Condensed italic bold, matching the pendón lettering — wordmark only, not other headings.
Do make the phone number a tel: link everywhere it appears — the primary user is on mobile.
Do keep the Azul Caja top stripe on the credential card — it is the visual stamp.
Do use rounded-sm (8px) on all interactive controls (buttons, inputs).
donts: Don't reintroduce amber/gold anywhere in the palette — it was based on an unrelated reference and does not match CLINITAXi's real signage.
Don't use success green (#0f8a4b) as a section label or eyebrow color.
Don't add a third shadow context beyond the nav glass and credential card.
Don't use gradient text — emphasis is weight and size.
Don't use hidden md:block on trust signals — the TrustBar must be visible on mobile.
Don't use plain <span> for the phone number — every appearance must be a tappable tel: link.
Don't use Azul Caja as a section background, including the header — on light pages it means CTA, not surface.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for section eyebrows — eyebrow kickers above headings are banned.
Don't apply the Saira Condensed wordmark font to running text or headings — it is reserved for the 'CLINITAXi' name-mark only.
